about: Simply throw fruits and stack them on the plate.
Combine fruits of the same kind to make them bigger!
Game over if the fruits fall off the plate!
The bigger the fruit, the higher your score!
Make chains for even higher scores!
Compete with players from all over the world and test your skills.
Aim for a high score and keep challenging yourself!
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
summary: Compete with players from all over the world and test your skills.
